author: ReTrace
description: ReTrace's own in-process meta-tools (reforge/agent.py), not an MCP server.

tools.name: add_finding
tools.capability: Writes a finding into the project. Changes stored state.

tools.name: attack_surface
tools.capability: Returns the dangerous-sink and input-source inventory.

tools.name: consult_methodology
tools.capability: Searches the local methodology knowledge base.

tools.name: exploitability
tools.capability: Deterministic severity suggestion from recorded evidence.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.capability: Lists artifacts registered on the project.

tools.name: parse_artifact
tools.capability: Resolves an artifact id to a path and routes it to a parser.

tools.name: read_artifact
tools.capability: Reads a bounded head of an uploaded artifact.

tools.name: record_dataflow
tools.capability: Records a source-to-sink chain on the project.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.capability: Retrieves matching MCP tools from the catalogue.

tools.name: vuln_checklist
tools.capability: Returns the investigation checklist for a vulnerability class.

tools.name: wait_for_reload
tools.capability: Waits for the operator to reload the target in the debugger.

tools.name: workflow_status
tools.capability: Reports the current workflow phase and suggested next steps.
